newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.457 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.457 pct.

text.p: The annual yield on the latest issue of Swiss federal government three-month money market claims is 1.457 percent, down from the previous issue's 1.780 percent, the Swiss National Bank said.
The latest issue, to be paid for on September 26, raised 1,011.05 million Swiss francs and was priced at 99.629 percent.
The previous issue, paid for on September 19, raised 902.30 million and was priced at 99.552 percent.
